semanticReview.method: Manual comparison with the Taiwan MOE Hanyu Pinyin initial table, ü spelling notes, and syllable tables

findings.supports: The official tables map ㄐ/ㄑ/ㄒ to j/q/x, provide ji/qi/xi examples, and list ju/qu/xu under the ü spelling rule.

limitations: Articulatory characteristics and Spanish letter comparisons were removed because the cited tables do not establish them.
